name: com.pebblepouch.lore
description: Worldbuilding inside the Unity Editor: organize your game's lore in Categories, Entries and Fields, link Entries in descriptions, track integrity and content health, and read everything at runtime through a small read-only API.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that reads a Lore Project at runtime: Categories, Entries, typed field values, descriptions and tags.

A complete demo Lore Project: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz as the lore of a small game. Import it only into a project without a Lore Project of its own; delete the imported sample folder before you create your own.
